heading: Strollers

tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: Except as provided in subsection (b), a covered air carrier shall not deny a passenger the ability to check a stroller at the departure gate if the stroller is being used by a passenger to transport a child traveling on the same flight as the passenger.

tree.heading: Exception.—
tree.text: Subsection (a) shall not apply in instances where the size or weight of the stroller poses a safety or security risk.

tree.heading: Covered Air Carrier Defined.—
tree.text: In this section, the term “covered air carrier” means an air carrier or a foreign air carrier as those terms are defined in section 40102 of title 49, United States Code.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 115–254, div. B, title IV, § 412(a), Oct. 5, 2018, 132 Stat. 3331.)
